registration: Primary targets, methods and optimization fixed before main training; input-capacity matching finalized before those arms trained; all method choices fixed before final test. 20ms/400Hz chosen from independent physics grid. Local protocol, not an external preregistration.
input_capacity_control: approximately 45k allocated parameters per model for each input; report narrower first-layer bottleneck in high-rate models

development_hpo.data: old Step1 seed11/22 or dedicated development data, never final confirmation data

alarm_threshold_grid: validation raw-score quantiles over 256 log-spaced upper-tail positions plus disabled; no test tuning; separate from isotonic probability calibration to preserve score ordering
physical_precision_claim: simulation finite-time normal resultant only; no hardware or full frictional GRF claim
precision_report: unit errors, bins, p95, tolerance curves; no universal exactness claim without downstream tolerance
test_policy: each locked confirmatory run evaluated once; failed execution may resume unchanged, no metric-guided retraining
scope: frozen locomotion; no replay/admittance/PPO or hardware commands
